_note: One Leader at a Time: previs of the Tholos of Schedia (set 'tholos', centre explorer (154, -45), floor 21.95). No cast: the image pass adds the people from the refs; each note is the picture's brief from the book.

cover.note: Inside the Tholos of Schedia in morning light: the round podium at the centre under the roof's lantern, its holder seated at the desk beside the board on its post, and runners in short brown tunics setting off from the podium towards the benches round the wall, each with a wax tablet. Through the porch door, the town's roofs and the bay.

o01-court.note: The Tholos from its paved court in the early morning: the round honey-coloured hall under its conical tiled roof, and legislators arriving by different doorways, one in a blue-grey himation, one in saffron, one in green; another in madder red leaving by the porch. No one speaks to anyone.

o02-podium.note: The podium close to: the holder, Liskovia in saffron, seated at the desk writing on a wax tablet, the blank board on its post beside her. Two runners in short brown tunics take tablets from the desk and set off down the steps in different directions, towards benches where legislators sit waiting.

o03-caller.note: A caller at their bench: Kleon, in green, writing invitations on small wax tablets, a new blank board propped against the bench. Runners wait to take them. Across the floor the podium stands empty, its desk bare.

o04-porch.note: Two scenes at once, split by the porch doorway. Outside on the porch, Okios in blue-grey writes at a small stand and hands a tablet to a runner. Inside, beyond the doorway, Liskovia in saffron sits at the podium's desk, and a new board hangs on its post.

o05-bench.note: A bench in the Tholos, close to: its stack of wax tablets smoothed blank, and the stone lip of the bench cut with a name and a board's count. Theron, in grey, has just sat down and runs a finger over the bare wax.
